name: tool-bridge-template
description: Deploy your own tool-bridge gateway to Cloudflare Workers in one click

TB_KV.description: Gateway state: node tree config, SecretKey hashes, plugin manifests.

TB_DEVICE.description: One Durable Object per connected device (WebSocket hibernation).

TB_SEARCH.description: D1 database backing the global tool-search index (`~search`).

TB_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_SK.description: Required. Generate once with `node -e "console.log('tbk_'+require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'))"`, save it in a password manager, and paste it here.

TB_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Required. SecretStore root key; generate with `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'))"`.
